refund-returns-policy.title: Refund and Returns Policy
refund-returns-policy.content:
MyHappyHour.co.ke Refund, Return, and Cancellation Policy

This policy details the specific terms for order cancellations, product returns, and experience booking refunds.

1. Order Cancellation (Physical Products)

  • Cancellation Window: You may request to cancel an order for a full refund within 10 minutes of placing it.
  • Post-Processing Cancellation: After 10 minutes OR once the order has been handed to the assigned driver, a cancellation fee of 10% of the order value will be deducted from your refund. If the order is in transit, the delivery fee will also be forfeited.

2. Returns for Physical Products (Drinks)

All sales are generally final. We will only accept returns or offer a refund/replacement if you notify us within 48 hours of delivery for the following verifiable conditions:

  • Damaged or Leaking Product
  • Incorrect Item Delivered
  • Defective/Spoiled Product (must be returned with a significant portion remaining).
    Non-Returnable Items: Change of mind, partially consumed products (unless defective), or products damaged after successful delivery.

3. Cancellations for Experiences & Tickets

When You Cancel (Notice Period Before Event)

Refund/Credit Policy

8 days or more

100% Full Refund (or 100% Store Credit).

Between 7 days and 72 hours

50% cash refund OR 100% Store Credit.

Less than 72 hours

No Refund or Credit will be issued.

Cancelled by MyHappyHour/Venue

100% full refund or option to rebook for a future date.

4. Refund Process

Contact Customer Support within the specified timeframe. Refunds will be processed within 5–10 business days of item verification.

terms-conditions.title: Terms & Conditions
terms-conditions.content:
MyHappyHour.co.ke General Terms and Conditions

Date of Last Revision: December 2025

By accessing MyHappyHour.co.ke, placing an order, or booking an experience, you agree to be bound by these General Terms and Conditions and all referenced Sub-Policies listed in Section 5.

Acceptance and Eligibility

1.1 Legal Drinking Age (Kenya Law)

By using this site, you warrant that you are 18 years of age or older, which is the legal drinking age in Kenya.

1.2 Age Verification
  • We reserve the right to request a valid National ID or Passport from the recipient upon delivery.
  • Mandatory Protocol: Our delivery personnel are required to follow a mandatory, non-negotiable protocol which includes visually verifying the recipient’s age against a government-issued ID upon arrival.
  • If the recipient fails verification or is visibly intoxicated, the delivery will be cancelled. A partial refund (less a delivery and restocking fee of up to 20% of the order value) will be issued.
1.3 Responsible Drinking

MyHappyHour.co.ke advocates for responsible drinking.

  • We reserve the right to set and enforce reasonable maximum quantity limits on orders.
  • Our delivery staff are authorized to refuse delivery if the recipient is visibly intoxicated or displays unsafe behaviour./li>
  • We shall not be held liable for any misuse of the products or any resultant harm, damage, or incident.
1.4 Order Placement and Acceptance

Your order is an offer to purchase. The contract is formed only when we send you a confirmation (via email/SMS) that your order has been accepted and dispatched.

2. Ordering and Payment

2.1 Pricing and Currency

All prices are listed in Kenyan Shillings (KES) and include applicable taxes (VAT) unless otherwise stated.

2.2 Payment Methods

We accept payments via M-Pesa and major credit/debit cards (Visa/MasterCard) only. Cash on Delivery (COD) is currently not accepted.

3. Disclaimers and Liability

3.1 Limitation of Liability
MyHappyHour.co.ke shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use our service or products.
3.2 Indemnity

You agree to hold MyHappyHour.co.ke harmless from any claims, damages, or costs arising from your breach of these Terms, your misuse of the service, or your violation of any law or the rights of a third party.

4. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

These Terms and your use of the site are governed by the laws of Kenya. Any dispute shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts of Kenya.

5. Incorporated Sub-Policies

The following policies contain specific, detailed terms and are fully incorporated into these General Terms and Conditions. 

  1. Refund, Return, and Cancellation Policy
  2. Delivery Policy
  3. Privacy Policy and Data Usage
  4. User Generated Content (UGC) Policy

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.content:
This Privacy Policy details how Nordic Beverages Limited ("Nordic Beverages", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, discloses, stores, and protects personal data belonging to visitors, registered users, and customers of the Happy Hour E-commerce Platform, in accordance with Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019 (the "DPA"), the Data Protection (General) Regulations, 2021, and the Alcoholic Drinks Control Act, 2010.

1 Introduction

Nordic Beverages Limited ("Nordic Beverages", "we", "us", or "our") operates the Happy Hour E-commerce Platform (the "Platform"), an online marketplace for the sale and delivery of alcoholic beverages and related products within Kenya.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, store, and protect personal data belonging to visitors, registered users, and customers of the Platform ("you" or "your"), in accordance with the Data Protection Act, 2019 (the "DPA"), the Data Protection (General) Regulations, 2021, and other applicable laws of Kenya, as well as internationally recognised data protection practices adopted by leading e-commerce platforms.

By creating an account, browsing the Platform, placing an order, or otherwise submitting personal data to us, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to the processing of your data. If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, please do not use the Platform.

2 Who We Are

For the purposes of the DPA, Nordic Beverages is the "data controller" and/or "data processor" responsible for your personal data.

Registered Name Nordic Beverages Limited
Registered Address The Billows, Kilimani, Nairobi
Privacy Enquiries Legal@nordic.com

3 Age Restriction and Eligibility to Purchase

Strict 18+ Age Requirement (Kenya Law)

Alcoholic beverages may only be sold to, and purchased by, persons who are 18 years of age or older, in accordance with the Alcoholic Drinks Control Act, 2010 and related county liquor licensing regulations. By registering an account or placing an order, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old.

  • • Registration-stage verification: We require you to confirm that you are 18 years and above and, where applicable, provide a national identity document or passport number to verify eligibility before you can complete a purchase.
  • • Delivery-stage verification: Our delivery riders or courier partners may be required to request a valid identification document from the recipient at the point of delivery, and may refuse delivery where age cannot be confirmed.

We do not knowingly offer the Platform to, or collect personal data from, individuals under 18 years of age.

4 Information We Collect

We collect the following categories of personal data:

(a) Identity & Account Information

Full name, age, phone number, email address.

(b) Order & Transaction Information

Products purchased, order value and history, delivery address, delivery instructions, order status, returns and complaints.

(c) Payment Information PCI-DSS Compliant

Mobile money details (e.g., M-Pesa phone number and transaction reference), card payment details, billing address, and transaction confirmations. Card and mobile money credentials are processed by our PCI-DSS-compliant payment service providers; we do not store full card numbers or mobile money PINs on our systems.

(d) Delivery & Location Information

Delivery address, and, where you grant permission through the Platform, real-time or approximate device location used to facilitate delivery and estimate delivery times.

(e) Device & Usage Information

IP address, device identifiers, browser type and version, operating system, referring/exit pages, clickstream data, and other diagnostic and log data collected automatically when you use the Platform.

(g) Communications & Support

Records of customer support enquiries, complaints, product reviews and ratings, and survey responses.

(h) Marketing Preferences

Your choices regarding receipt of promotional emails, SMS, WhatsApp messages, or push notifications.

5 How We Collect Your Information

  • • Directly from you: when you register an account, complete checkout, contact customer support, respond to surveys, or otherwise interact with the Platform.
  • • Automatically: through cookies, analytics tools, and server logs when you use the Platform.

6 How We Use Your Information

We use personal data for the following purposes:

  • To create, maintain, and secure your account
  • To process, fulfil, and deliver orders with delivery partners
  • To process payments via mobile money & card gateways
  • To provide customer support and handle returns
  • To send transactional order & delivery updates
  • To send consented marketing & promotions
  • To personalise shopping & product recommendations
  • To maintain, test, and improve Platform analytics
  • To enable you to participate in promotions, competitions, and surveys

7 Legal Basis for Processing

Consent

For marketing communications, optional cookies, and certain data sharing with marketing or advertising partners. You may withdraw your consent at any time, including by clicking "unsubscribe" at the bottom of any marketing email.

Performance of a Contract

To process and deliver the orders you place with us, including using your contact details and payment information to fulfil and deliver your order.

Our Legitimate Business Interests

Where necessary for us to understand our customers, and operate and improve the Platform, provided this does not unduly affect your privacy and other rights.

Compliance with a Legal Obligation

Where we are required to process personal data to comply with an obligation under Kenyan law.

8 Cookies and Similar Technologies

We and our service providers use cookies, pixels, SDKs, and similar tracking technologies to operate and improve the Platform, including:

  • Strictly necessary cookies: required for core functions such as login and checkout.
  • Performance and analytics cookies: used to understand how users interact with the Platform.
  • Functional cookies: used to remember your preferences.
  • Advertising and targeting cookies: used to deliver relevant promotions, subject to your consent.

You can manage or disable cookies through your browser or device settings, and through the cookie preference banner presented on the Platform. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Platform.

9 Marketing Communications

Where you have opted in, we may send you marketing communications by email, SMS, WhatsApp, or push notification. You may withdraw consent at any time by:

  • • Clicking the "unsubscribe" link included in marketing emails; or
  • • Replying "STOP" to marketing SMS messages; or
  • • Writing to Legal@nordic.com requesting withdrawal.

10 Sharing and Disclosure of your Information

🛡️ Zero Data Selling: We do not sell your personal data. We only share personal data with the following categories of recipients as necessary for specified purposes:
  • Payment service providers: Mobile money operators and licensed payment gateways/processors to process and confirm payments.
  • Delivery and logistics partners: Third-party courier companies and independent riders, who receive your name, phone number, and delivery address as necessary to fulfil your order.
  • Regulators and public authorities: Where required by law, court order, or to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

When we share your personal data with third parties, we require them to agree to protect your data in accordance with this Policy and applicable law, and we only permit them to process your personal data for the specified purposes and in accordance with our instructions. We do not allow our third-party service providers to use your personal data for their own independent purposes.

11 Data Retention

We take every reasonable step to ensure that your personal data is processed for the minimum period necessary for the purposes set out in this Policy. Your personal data may be retained in a form that allows for identification for as long as:

  • We maintain an ongoing relationship with you, so that we can provide the Platform to you and ensure you receive communications you have requested; or
  • Your personal data is necessary in connection with the purposes set out in this Policy and we have a valid legal basis for retaining it.

We actively review the personal data we hold and delete it securely, or in some cases anonymise it, when there is no longer a legal, business, or customer need for it to be retained.

12 Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction, including encryption of data in transit and at rest, access controls, staff confidentiality obligations and training, engagement of PCI-DSS-compliant payment partners, and periodic security testing.

We limit access to your personal data to those with a genuine business need to know it, and your personal data may only be processed on our instructions, subject to a duty of confidentiality.

13 Your Rights under the Data Protection Act, 2019

Please keep us informed if your personal data changes while you hold an account with us. Subject to applicable exceptions, you have the right to:

1. Be informed of the use to which your personal data is put
2. Access your personal data held by us
3. Request correction or rectification of inaccurate data
4. Request erasure of your personal data
5. Request restriction of processing
6. Data portability in a structured machine-readable format
7. Object to processing based on legitimate interests/marketing
8. Human review on automated processing decisions
Response Commitment: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at Legal@nordic.com. We may need to verify your identity before processing your request, and we will respond within 21 days of receipt, extendable by a further 21 days where reasonably necessary, with notice to you.

14 Children's Privacy

The Platform is not directed at, and must not be used by, individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected personal data from a person under 18, we will take reasonable steps to delete that data without undue delay.

15 Call Centre, USSD, and Recorded Communications

Where you contact our customer care team by phone, WhatsApp, USSD, or live chat, we may collect your phone number, the content of your enquiry, and, where applicable, a recording or transcript of the call for quality assurance, staff training, dispute resolution purposes.

Recorded calls are retained for 30 days unless required for longer to resolve an ongoing dispute or complaint.

16 Loyalty, Rewards, and Referral Programmes

If you enroll in any loyalty, rewards, discount-voucher, or referral programme we may offer (for example, earning points on purchases or referring a friend for a discount code), we will collect additional information such as your points balance, redemption history, referral code usage, and the identity of referred users to the extent necessary to administer the programme and prevent abuse. Participation is optional, and you may withdraw at any time; withdrawal may result in forfeiture of unredeemed points or vouchers in accordance with the programme terms.

17 Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, the Platform, or applicable law. We will post the updated version on the Platform.

19 Governing Law

This Privacy Policy is governed by, and shall be construed in accordance with, the laws of the Republic of Kenya, including the Data Protection Act, 2019, and its subsidiary regulations. Any disputes arising in connection with this Policy shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Kenya.

20 Related Practices and Information

This Privacy Policy should be read together with the following related documents:

Terms and Conditions User Generated Content (UGC) Policy Refund & Returns Policy

By submitting, posting, or tagging MyHappyHour.co.ke in any content (on social media, our website, or at any official MyHappyHour physical event), you explicitly agree to these UGC terms and grant MyHappyHour.co.ke a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, and display your UGC in our marketing and promotional materials.

2. Warranties (Third-Party IP Protection)

You confirm you own the UGC or have secured all necessary rights and permissions from any third-party contributors (including photographers) to grant us this license.

3. Responsible UGC

UGC must not promote excessive/irresponsible drinking or feature persons under the legal drinking age. We reserve the right to remove non-compliant content.
